verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a cloud-backed agent-orchestration platform like HumanLayer, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of retention policies, retention settings, or deletion of tasks, sessions or artifacts. Self-hosting compute or running the stack on your own workstation concerns where work runs, not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
